tools.name: medicare_drug_plans_2027
tools.description: Every 2027 Medicare plan with drug coverage CMS lists for a county: stand-alone drug plans (with Original Medicare) and Medicare Advantage plans, each with company, monthly premium, change from 2026, drug deductible and, for stand-alone plans, the premium with Extra Help. Give a ZIP code, or a state

tools.name: denial_code_lookup
tools.description: What an insurance or Medicare denial code on an explanation of benefits means: a Claim Adjustment Reason Code (e.g. CO-97, PR-1, 197) or a Remark Code (e.g. M15, N432), from the X12 code lists. With a prefix it says whether the person may owe the amount (CO is the provider's write-off, PR is patient

tools.name: appeal_deadline
tools.description: The last day to file an appeal of a Medicare, Medicare Advantage, Part D or commercial/ACA/employer plan denial, counted the way the rules count it (Medicare presumes receipt 5 days after the notice date), with days remaining, who decides, and the next level. Not legal advice; confirm the exact date

tools.name: hcpcs_lookup
tools.description: What a HCPCS Level II code on a bill, supplier invoice or explanation of benefits describes (a letter and four digits, e.g. E0601, J9271, A4253), with its Medicare coverage status, from CMS's quarterly HCPCS file. CPT codes (five digits) are not covered: their descriptions are copyrighted.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "hcpcs_lookup" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
